-------------------------

We may collect the following information:

*   Name
*   Email address
*   Phone number
*   Billing details
*   Company information

------------------------------

We use your information to:

*   Provide and manage our services
*   Process payments securely
*   Improve website performance and user experience
*   Send invoices, updates, and support information
*   Prevent fraud and unauthorized activities

---------------------

All online payments are processed securely through Razorpay. We do not store your complete card details on our servers.

### Data Protection
------------------

We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure.

We may use trusted third-party services for payment processing, analytics, hosting, and communication purposes.

### User Rights
--------------

You may request to:

*   Access your personal data

*   Delete your data where applicable

### Policy Updates
-----------------

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page.

### Secure Payments
------------------

All online payments are processed securely through Razorpay, ensuring that your payment information is protected and secure.

For additional information, please contact us at info@ingrainsystem.com or call +91-9010481048.

intents.name: about
intents.answer:
# Iryax Global Overview
=====================================

Iryax Global is an enterprise technology company.
-----------------------------------------------

### What They Do

Iryax Global connects the best tools into one platform, creating a unified ecosystem where businesses operate as one system.

### Problems Solved

#### Key Challenges

* Disconnected data
* No visibility
* Teams in silos
* Time lost switching systems
* Multiple logins with no connection

#### Solution

Iryax Global solves these problems by:

1. Providing a single user ID and password for access to multiple tools.
2. Allowing users to access multiple tools in one platform.
3. Integrating data across systems for complete visibility.
4. Offering a single dashboard for streamlined operations.

### Mission

Iryax Global aims to help businesses stop managing tools and start running their operations more efficiently.

For additional information, please contact us at info@ingrainsystem.com or call +91-9010481048.
